name: dumbbell curl press extension
description: Curl, press and overhead extension chained into one rep with dumbbells, giving the biceps, shoulders and triceps a full workout.
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights behind your head.
Extend your arms, then bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders and down to your sides.
Keep your torso still and choose a manageable weight.
